route_separation_contract.abi_kernel_decisions: Consultations of crates/frankenlibc-abi/src/runtime_policy.rs KERNEL_CELL RuntimeMathKernel::decide (synchronous non-hot hardened families, strict observation when KERNEL_STATE == STATE_READY, and observe()-driven hot-family cache refreshes).
route_separation_contract.pipeline_kernel_decisions: Consultations of ValidationPipeline::runtime_math RuntimeMathKernel::decide on cold pointer-validation misses inside frankenlibc-membrane (bypassed when FRANKENLIBC_RUNTIME_MATH=off, and escalating INTEGRITY_SOURCE_PIPELINE_PTR_VALIDATOR when PointerValidation conformal risk >= 750000 ppm).
route_separation_contract.independent_bounds_validations: MembraneMetrics::validations + known_remaining* / maybe_clamp_copy_len* / tracked_region_fits* independent bounds, arena, SipHash fingerprint, and canary checks. Remains active under FRANKENLIBC_RUNTIME_MATH=off.
route_separation_contract.ffi_pcc_decisions: Static proof-carried certificate fast-exits (lookup_active_ffi_pcc_certificate_with_index, decide_certified_memcmp, and try_decide_certified_string_pcc). Automatically declined in hardened mode when FRANKENLIBC_RUNTIME_MATH=off or HOT_FAMILY_ESCALATED_MASK marks the family escalated.
route_separation_contract.hot_cached_decisions: O(1) CACHED_HOT_HARDENED_DECISION reads on the 7 high-frequency hardened families (Deny falls through to synchronous k.decide), refreshed by observe() on 100% of adverse events and sampled benign calls (1-in-64 Allocator, 1-in-256 other hot families + IoFd), with escalation gated on per-family conformal risk >= 750000 ppm.
route_separation_contract.math_off_bypasses: Explicit FRANKENLIBC_RUNTIME_MATH=off bypasses in runtime_policy::decide (including certified hardened calls) and ValidationPipeline that skip RuntimeMathKernel consultation while keeping independent bounds/canary/quarantine validation active.

causal_consumers.trigger: observe() and ValidationPipeline feed RuntimeMathKernel::observe_validation_result and refresh CACHED_HOT_HARDENED_DECISION[family]; escalation triggers when family_conformal_risk_ppm(family) >= 750000 or action is Deny.
causal_consumers.observable_effect: Sets ESCALATED_INTEGRITY_SOURCES bitmask to tighten frankenlibc_membrane::tls_cache::warm_integrity_cadence_mask from 15 (1-in-16) to 0 (1-in-1 every-access SipHash header + trailing canary verification), declines try_decide_certified_string_pcc and active_unescalated_ffi_pcc_by_index static fast-exits, routes decide() through runtime_policy.hot_cached.decide, increments variant_upgrades on UpgradeToSafeVariant, and immediately detects non-tail heap canary corruption on every warm buffer read (returning clamped 0 instead of warm cached length).

causal_consumers.trigger: runtime_policy::decide consults RuntimeMathKernel::decide synchronously on ABI entry and updates HOT_FAMILY_ESCALATED_MASK from family_conformal_risk_ppm(family) >= 750000 or action == Deny (de-escalating via 1-in-256 benign observe sampling once conformal risk recovers).
causal_consumers.observable_effect: tracked_region_fits_for_decision -> malloc_abi::tracked_region_fits_for_decision forces single-lock AllocationArena::verify_live_integrity_from(addr) instead of trusting a warm 1-in-16 TLS_CACHE hit, accurately attributing fingerprint_failures vs canary_failures, bumping shard epochs, and immediately rejecting corrupted live heap buffers with -1/EFAULT on connect/send/recv/sendto/recvfrom/pread/pwrite while allowing all valid buffers and syscalls.
